detail: The repo lookup cache and its 30-a-minute budget are shared by agents and the operator (timing side channel; agents can starve the operator). Agent-supplied paths reach the handoff checkout reader, which has no timeout or concurrency cap. Paths match case-insensitively but URL paths case-sensitively, and IDN/punycode hosts are not unified. An applied policy binding both spellings of a web prefix to different spaces fails to load at the next orchd start.
